title: Convert old reports into reports/<exam>/<line>/run-<id> with reviewed dry-run, backup, manifest, undo (REQ-0099)
acceptance_criteria: AC2 dry-run shown to the user before apply, INDEX.md per run folder
AC3 apply with backup, manifest, undo, recount equal
AC4 readers accept new and legacy report layouts, flat pack gets a line+run folder
AC5 tests and QA recount, no report content changed

design.summary: plansmigrate --root reports grouping files of one old folder into reports/<exam>/<line>/run-<newest mtime>; 10 folders -> 11 runs, 0 keep, 0 UNMAPPED; pack -> dgnl2026/f/run-<id> with run.json linking 4 plan runs; crosscheck -> dgnl2026/f superseded via run.json; INDEX.md per run; map written by --write-map and hand-reviewed; tree_stats hashes every report file; readers accept legacy and new; real --apply after the user reviews the dry-run

implementation.summary: plansmigrate --root reports groups each old report folder into reports/<exam>/<line>/run-<newest mtime> with run.json (plan runs linked by result_sha256 for the pack, link unknown otherwise), superseded status in run.json, INDEX.md per run; reports map written (10 folders -> 11 report runs, 84 moves, 0 keep, 0 UNMAPPED); scratch apply+verify+undo equal for every file; check_report_pack 53 checks 0 failed on the moved copy; real reports/ and plans/ untouched

unit_test.result: gate: ran 1852, new=[], known=4, gate_ok true, 367.2 s, worktree removed; test_plansmigrate 57 OK (21 new, ReportsPhase2 rewritten); --fast 1832 tests 53.9 s only the 4 known

security.result: os.rename inside reports/ only, backup outside the root verified before the move, map entries confined to reports/, no shell, no content file edited; undo via MIGRATION.json or the backup

verification.command: plans-migrate --root reports --dry-run, --apply --backup-dir work/backups (user: apply), --verify; independent recount from the saved before-sha; readers; gate --full
verification.result: real apply: 11 report runs, 81 files moved, 30 generated; --verify 8 checks 0 failed; 112/112 content files equal sha256 at the new paths (0 different, 0 missing); files 153 = 112 + 11 run.json + 19 INDEX.md + MIGRATION.json + 10 index copies; pack run.json links 4 plan runs by result_sha256 (match the real result.json); run-list report-runs column and pack checker (64 checks, 0 failed, 113/120) work on the moved tree; superseded rows present for crosscheck and dhqg2024/solutions*, none for the pack; gate ran 1852, new=[], known=4

quality.reason: real apply on the real reports/ tree with backup, --verify 8 checks, independent sha256 recount of all 112 content files against a saved snapshot

user_notes.note: convert old reports; user reviews the dry-run before apply
